sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Removes resurrection, wards, invincibility, damage reflection, continuous healing, and damage reduction effects.
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 400. Success value 100. 4x physical damage (Light).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Grief (10% chance to increase Damage by 50%) for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces Unison gauge gains by 3 for 60 seconds.
-Applies Field Obstacle to the enemy Field.
-Target: all allies. Applies kijin (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction; boosts Ability Power of critical hits by 50; increases attack Ability accuracy by 30%; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking) for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies blessing (recovers 50 Cost, increases max HP by 100%, nullifies status ailments and Unison Gauge reduction effects, reduces cooldown times by 50%, and recovers 20% of max HP every 5 seconds) for 90 seconds.
Increases all elemental Unison damage Ability Power by 50 when equipped in the Main Slot.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 14000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 14000
